1. Read SKILL.md.
2. Tried a search filter — failed (search field undefined).
3. Introspected the Issue type.
4. Introspected IssueFilter etc.
5. Listed all 5 issues.
6. Queried the relations for WEB-1 (Checkout crash on Safari). The relation node: type "blocks", issue = WEB-1, relatedIssue = WEB-5.
